scope.catalog_note: The frozen expectations describe figures as out-of-catalog. These transcript files record bundle hashes but not the attachment text; no independent catalog audit is claimed.

status_definitions.pass: Recorded text adequately satisfies the stated expectation at its requested planning level.
status_definitions.partial: Some requested behavior is delivered, with a material format or evidence limitation; not automatically a demonstrated failure.
status_definitions.fail: Recorded text contradicts or misses a stated requirement.
status_definitions.not-observable: Available text does not settle the full claim; do not infer hidden state or silently treat it as a failure.

cross_cutting_findings.reason: Visible custom Ocean Explorers and Quiet Rebels groups avoid a mandatory four-group menu. Chinese changes visibly perform full replacement to exactly two, then addition to five; English changes visibly perform one-member replacement, then whole-cast replacement to five. Generic moderator, staff and participant jobs are not counted as extra personas.

All eight recorded plans preserve the library and 18-year-old friend audience, a 30-minute schedule, the applicable currency ceiling, two staff and no app. English also preserves no paid advertising. Chinese never requested an added no-paid-advertising rule; do not invent that requirement. Arithmetic and interval continuity checked, not actual purchasing or workforce feasibility.

Early rounds contain concrete changes to others’ mechanisms, not just praise or separate speeches. Final turns synthesize and simplify instead of replaying every member; this is appropriate to the practical-plan request.

Useful ideas and decisions precede optional Continue controls. Staff pretesting, choosing local books and confirming logistics are ordinary execution tasks, not a demand that the user brainstorm before help is provided. Chinese final plan still leaves actual puzzle production to preparation.

cross_cutting_findings.topic: fictional viewpoints versus impersonation or execution
cross_cutting_findings.reason: Conversation-level framing identifies fictional editorial roles, not authentic speech/endorsement. Recorded responses do not claim real people attended, that outreach or events happened, or that local prices/demand were verified. Historical roles and cultural authenticity were not fact-checked in this text-only review.

cross_cutting_findings.topic: mobile scanning and literal one-page fit
cross_cutting_findings.reason: Multi-stage workshop output is long; headings/tables help but repeat proposals, comparison and full plan. Chinese final output remains dense despite a one-page request. This is qualitative editorial feedback; device usability and actual pagination are not observable without rendering.

The final answer explicitly acknowledges five-person co-creation and continues earlier mechanics but does not list current names. No reset is shown. Do not infer hidden role state, penalize missing introductions as certain failure, or claim all five names were visibly retained.

No actual pilot, human acceptance, device test, paid/unpaid outreach execution or ChatGPT website attachment activation was performed. Chinese pilot needs puzzle assets; both pilots need local staffing/date/resource confirmation. Do not claim the small sample establishes demand or universal behavior.

recommended_follow_up: If one-page delivery matters, evaluate a fixed rendered page and a phone-sized viewport; do not equate a heading saying one-page with verified fit.
If exact final roster observability is required, test a compact five-name continuity line rather than demanding repeated biographies or a fresh workshop.
Evaluate the authored Chinese puzzle materials separately before describing the plan as print-ready.
Run actual target-user acceptance and native website attachment tests separately; retain real outputs and do not conflate these with this recorded API-style trial.
reviewer_type: Separate AI review task; not a human acceptance study or blind human rating
